name: jacobi1d
signature: void jacobi1d(long tsteps, long n, double *A, double *B)
layout: A and B have n elements. Both are input and output: the function updates them starting from their initial values. Only elements 1 to n-2 are written; elements 0 and n-1 of both arrays are fixed boundary values. A and B do not overlap. n is at least 3 and tsteps is at least 1.
